test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On 15 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

• No book is a copy.

• All stones are books.

Conclusions:

(I) No copy is a stone.

(II) All books are stones.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/380394e4acc0989023398c33aa312c6216c8588c3d1fb207510e9366c00c36f6.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) No copy is a stone → Follow (As no book is a copy and all stones are books. As whole stones comes in books which cannot be copy, therefore it is true.)

(II) All books are stones → Does not follow (As all stones are books. So it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion (I) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2"
